purpose: Answer exactly what the customer asked FTL to price.
what_it_may_change: Only confirmed requested scope and controlled quantities/SKUs.
what_it_must_not_do: No typical-MOD add-ons; no separate alternates; no guessed equipment.
output_when_not_applicable: Always required for a qualified pricing enquiry.

purpose: Show the FTL-preferred modernization solution where an approved FTL rule supports a better path.
what_it_may_change: Only the controlled decision branch - e.g., approved universal-car-door recommendation.
what_it_must_not_do: Do not invent upgrades simply to increase quote value.
output_when_not_applicable: NO VALID RECOMMENDED VARIANT if no approved recommendation exists.

purpose: Show a real consultant/customer alternate or broader approved configuration.
what_it_may_change: Only source-defined or approved FTL alternate scope.
what_it_must_not_do: Do not fill a third quote for the sake of having three.

purpose: Keep all variants under one project/enquiry.
what_it_may_change: Show added/removed lines, quantity/configuration changes, price delta, reason, review flags.
what_it_must_not_do: Do not let variants drift to different base scope.
